rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a sudden urge that prompts someone to act.

example.english: I bought such expensive shoes on impulse.
example.traditional: 我一時衝動買咗對咁貴嘅鞋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 si4 cung1 dung6 maai5 zo2 deoi3 gam3 gwai3 ge3 haai4

rows.note: Use this for a physical thrust or force, especially in mechanics or descriptions of motion.

example.english: This rocket needs enough impulse to lift off.
example.traditional: 呢部火箭要有足夠推力先可以升空。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 fo2 zin3 jiu3 jau5 zuk1 gau3 teoi1 lik6 sin1 ho2 ji5 sing1 hung1
